releaseNotes: Added MyAnimeList public profile import to Anime Tracker, with source selection when AniList and MyAnimeList both match a username.
Improved Smart File Transfer beta behavior, including transfer-code normalization for shared codes and clearer beta labeling.
Added Auto Clicker toggle mode so the activation bind can turn clicking on/off instead of requiring hold.
Improved Reminders smart-title parsing for shorthand times like 3m, 3 min, and 1h30m, with safer handling of oversized numbers.
Polished update, reminder, anime import, and settings UI details.
